summary: Kunshan Chipinfos Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a third-party provider specializing in high-end chip testing and management services. They operate a joint testing laboratory in Shanghai and offer a range of services from product performance testing to supply chain solutions, catering to advanced technology sectors.
